system.description:
From your own liquid body, you conjure a clone of yourself, using the Water Clone technique as a base, but this clone is far more cartoonish in its design and look, and is known as a Steam Imp. You can command the imp as a bonus action on your turns. It uses your Ninjutsu attack bonus and Save DC for effects that require an attack or saving throw. Strength, Dexterity and Constitution saving throws this creature makes use your Ninjutsu ability modifier as its proficiency bonus.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3.

Steam Imp

Medium Construct, unaligned

Armor Class 14 + Your Ninjutsu Ability Modifier

Hit Points 10

Speed 30 ft

| | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save |

| STR | +7 | + | CON | +4 | + | WIS | +0 | - |

| DEX | +3 | + | INT | -5 | - | CHA | -5 | -5 |

Damage Immunities Cold, Fire

Condition Immunities All Mental, All Sensory, Chilled, Bleed, Envenomed

Senses passive Perception 10

Mists Tyranny. When the Steam Imp is reduced to 0 Hit points, it uses its Detonation ability.

Looping Destruction (B-Rank). At the beginning of your following turn, if the Steam Imp has detonated since the beginning of your last turn and you are concentrating on the jutsu used to summon the Steam Imp and either the Misty Hallucination, Water Balloon, or Demonic Illusion: Steaming Mirage Hijutsu, the Steam Imp is summoned again at no additional cost.

Growing Pains. At the end of each of your turns, following the turn used to summon this Steam Imp, the Steam Imp grows in size by 1 stage. If the Steam Imp grows to be Huge, it uses the Detonation ability.

Attacks

Multiattack (B-Rank). The Steam can attack 2 times with its Arm Blade.

Arm Blade. Melee Weapon Attack: reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 1d12 + 7 Slashing damage. Beginning at A-Rank, this attack deals an additional +1d12 cold damage.

Detonation: The Steam Imp cannot spend an action to use this ability. When the Steam Imp Detonates, its hit points are reduced to 0 and all creatures within 15 feet of it must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take 6d6 cold damage and constructs and structures treat damage from this effect as if they are vulnerable. This increases by +1d6 for every rank beyond C-Rank.
